column2: We’ve	expanded	our	support	for	the	nonprofit	sector	over	the	last	year.	We
work	closely	with	nonprofit	organizations	around	the	world	to	help	them
accelerate their organizational transformation with technology.
Microsoft	matches	employee	donations	of	time	and	money	to	nonprofit
organizations	of	their	choice.	In	fiscal	2019,	Microsoft	has	donated	or	provided
discounted software and services worth more $1.5 billion via Microsoft
Philanthropies. Our employees generously donated an additional $170 million
(including company match) through our employee giving program to support
